summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; source and Accepted ADRs are fact authority, projections/indexes derived_cache only; deterministic Locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence, never synthesized facts; callers reread/hash-verify sources; trusted adapters fix domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence, LLM query intent untrusted and cannot widen envelope; VDD records post-reread accept/reject, rejected candidates do not satisfy required modules, uncovered modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses only VDD-frozen decisions; Bootstrap Review may locate before prepare and freezes context in Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback disabled unless approved, then Python only via scripts/sc/_llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins local refs/heads/main, no implicit fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation, only derived artifacts and append-only evidence; extends ADR-0044; complements and does not supersede ADR-0037/0041/0043/0044; failures fail closed; authorizes no phase routes, Hosted E2 changes, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, or commit
